title: Possessory – Home Inventory & Warranty Tracker
short_description: Keep belongings, receipts and warranty details beautifully organised on your device.
description: Give everything you own a place. Possessory helps you record household belongings by room, attach receipts and photos, track warranty dates and organise maintenance. Core inventory functions work offline and no account is required. Create user-maintained inventory records and choose what to include before exporting. Speech recognition depends on device support and may use a network service. Reports are not insurer-certified valuations. This listing is a draft and must not be published before release validation.
hero_caption: Keep everything you own beautifully organised.

warranties_caption: Keep receipts and warranty details together.
ocr_caption: Review purchase details with less typing.

voice_caption: Use supported voice commands on compatible devices.
reminders_caption: Keep track of upcoming warranty dates.
iap_description: One-time upgrade for unlimited belongings and multiple households, receipt OCR, advanced warranty reminders, maintenance, PDF/CSV/JSON reports, saved searches, expanded voice commands and password-protected backups. No subscription. Purchase verification requires internet.
